newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Banco Frances cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Banco Frances cut.

text.p: -- Robert Flemings said on Tuesday it had cut its rating for Argentina's Banco Frances to hold from long-term buy.

-- Analyst Jorge Scarinci wrote in a report, "Even though we believe that BF will benefit from a recovery of the Argentine economy and the ongoing concentration in Argentina's banking sector, we see the bank running at a slower pace than Banco de Galicia (Buy), which is currently trading at $24.50/ADR."
-- Banco Frances' American Depositary Receipt was off 1/4 to 30 in mid-afternoon trade.
